ProjectsUrban Nest

07Interior Design

URBANNEST

Category
Interior Design
Location
Copenhagen, Denmark
Year
2024
Area
62 m²

AOverview

A compact 62 m² apartment redesigned with built-in joinery, soft textures and hidden storage.

Urban Nest transforms a compact city apartment into a calm, flexible home for a young couple who work from home. Every centimetre was drawn to serve two or three purposes.

BDesign Concept

THE BIGIDEA.

We treated the plan as a piece of furniture. A continuous oak wall conceals storage, a fold-down desk and a hidden bed, so rooms can change character between day and night.

Fig. 02 — Deep green sofa on pale floors

C

The challenge

Low ceilings, a narrow plan and limited daylight made the space feel cramped, and the clients refused to give up generous seating or a proper dining table.

A

Our approach

Warm, pale finishes, mirrored niches and brass pendant lights lift the space, while rounded corners and a lowered seating zone create cosy intimacy.
